title: 24 Hours of Freedom
description: 1 elapsed day equals 24 hours, or 1,440 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 1 elapsed 24-hour day = 24 hours = 1,440 minutes.

title: Two Days of Endurance
description: 2 elapsed days equal 48 hours, or 2,880 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 2 x 24 hours = 48 hours = 2,880 minutes.

title: Three Days of Perseverance
description: 3 elapsed days equal 72 hours, or 4,320 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 3 x 24 hours = 72 hours = 4,320 minutes.

title: A Five-Day Stretch
description: 5 elapsed days equal 120 hours, or 7,200 minutes. That is one five-day span, measured continuously.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 5 x 24 hours = 120 hours = 7,200 minutes.

title: One Full Week
description: 7 elapsed days equal 168 hours, or 10,080 minutes: one sequence of seven 24-hour days.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 7 x 24 hours = 168 hours = 10,080 minutes. The title references the seven-day motif in Genesis 2:1-3.

title: Daniel's Ten-Day Test
description: 10 elapsed days equal 240 hours, or 14,400 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 10 x 24 hours = 240 hours = 14,400 minutes. The title references Daniel 1:12-15.

title: Two Weeks of Perseverance
description: 14 elapsed days equal 336 hours, or 20,160 minutes: exactly two seven-day weeks.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 14 x 24 hours = 336 hours = 20,160 minutes; 14 days = 2 x 7 days.

title: Three Weeks of Steadfastness
description: 21 elapsed days equal 504 hours, or 30,240 minutes: exactly three seven-day weeks.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 21 x 24 hours = 504 hours = 30,240 minutes; 21 days = 3 x 7 days. Daniel 10:2-3 is a three-week motif.

title: Thirty Days of Steadfastness
description: 30 elapsed days equal 720 hours, or 43,200 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 30 x 24 hours = 720 hours = 43,200 minutes.

title: The Biblical Forty Days
description: 40 elapsed days equal 960 hours, or 57,600 minutes. The title reflects forty-day periods referenced in Scripture.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 40 x 24 hours = 960 hours = 57,600 minutes. Forty-day references: Matthew 4:1-2, Exodus 34:28, and 1 Kings 19:8.

title: The Pentecost Count
description: 50 elapsed days equal 1,200 hours, or 72,000 minutes. The title refers to the count described in Leviticus 23:15-16.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 50 x 24 hours = 1,200 hours = 72,000 minutes. Leviticus 23:15-16 describes a count of fifty days.

title: Sixty Days of Steadfastness
description: 60 elapsed days equal 1,440 hours, or 86,400 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 60 x 24 hours = 1,440 hours = 86,400 minutes.

title: Seventy-Five Days of Perseverance
description: 75 elapsed days equal 1,800 hours, or 108,000 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 75 x 24 hours = 1,800 hours = 108,000 minutes.

title: Ninety Days of Steadfastness
description: 90 elapsed days equal 2,160 hours, or 129,600 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 90 x 24 hours = 2,160 hours = 129,600 minutes.

title: One Hundred and Twenty Days
description: 120 elapsed days equal 2,880 hours, or 172,800 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 120 x 24 hours = 2,880 hours = 172,800 minutes.

title: The One Hundred and Fifty-Day Account
description: 150 elapsed days equal 3,600 hours, or 216,000 minutes. The title references the duration stated in Genesis 7:24 and 8:3.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 150 x 24 hours = 3,600 hours = 216,000 minutes. Genesis 7:24 and 8:3 provide the scriptural motif.

title: One Hundred and Eighty Days
description: 180 elapsed days equal 4,320 hours, or 259,200 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 180 x 24 hours = 4,320 hours = 259,200 minutes.

title: Two Hundred and Seventy Days
description: 270 elapsed days equal 6,480 hours, or 388,800 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 270 x 24 hours = 6,480 hours = 388,800 minutes.

title: Three Hundred and Sixty-Five Days
description: 365 elapsed days equal 8,760 hours, or 525,600 minutes: 52 weeks plus one day.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 365 x 24 hours = 8,760 hours = 525,600 minutes; 365 days = 52 x 7 days + 1 day.

title: Five Hundred Days
description: 500 elapsed days equal 12,000 hours, or 720,000 minutes.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 500 x 24 hours = 12,000 hours = 720,000 minutes.

title: Two 365-Day Spans
description: 730 elapsed days equal 17,520 hours, or 1,051,200 minutes: two spans of 365 days each.
sourceNote: Duration arithmetic: 730 x 24 hours = 17,520 hours = 1,051,200 minutes; 730 days = 2 x 365 days.
